note: REVIEW DRAFT for modules 6-24 (levels 106-504). NOT wired into the app: modules.json still carries modules 1-5 only, and biblical_themes.json / scripture_library.json are unchanged. Promotion (Phase 2) appends each module entry + theme passages + library texts, then runs validators. Micro IDs use the generic mNN scheme (avoids the old seed_*/growth_* dual-ID confusion). Triggers follow the house cadence: micros at lvl_mNN_05/10/15/20, parable at lvl_mNN_challenge. Library KJV is filled where short and certain; longer parable texts and all NET entries are marked TODO to be lifted from a verified source at implementation (the journal integrity test requires every reference KEY to exist; placeholder text must never ship). This draft supersedes scripture_pack_2_draft.json (its 6 parable candidates are absorbed below).
